page_title: Readest — Free Open-Source EPUB & PDF Reader for All Platforms

summary.name: Readest
summary.one_liner: Readest is a free, open-source EPUB and PDF ebook reader for deep, immersive reading with highlights, notes, split-screen reading, text-to-speech, and cloud sync.
use_cases: reading two books or translations side by side
comparing texts for research or study
translating or looking up words while reading
reading EPUB and PDF files in one app
summary.what_it_does: Readest opens EPUB and PDF files and offers highlights, bookmarks, notes, and search across an ebook library. Its Parallel Read mode shows two documents in a split-screen view with synchronized scrolling and navigation. Users can adjust fonts, margins, line spacing, and themes such as light, dark, and sepia. Built-in tools translate paragraphs with DeepL integration and look up terms on Wikipedia without leaving the book. An AI-powered text-to-speech feature reads ebooks aloud, and highlights, notes, and reading progress sync automatically between devices.
notable: Parallel Read split-screen mode with synchronized scrolling
Built-in DeepL paragraph translation and Wikipedia lookup
Cross-device sync of highlights, notes, and reading progress
caveats: DeepL translation integration is named but its terms or costs are not stated on the page
Cloud sync details and any paid tiers are not described on the page
